answer: A sybil farm must split its bond across many identities, so each fake account carries thin stake and earns little trust. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation: each agent must lock a bond to attest peers, and attestations decay unless the agent keeps contributing. Honest agents like a steady falcon accumulate reputation over time, while fakes must wander between new keys, paying registration and bond costs each cycle.
